J-01.note: Verified via full-pipeline browser-QA (UT-02/UT-05/UT-11): /stocks renders 120 leaderboard rows, each with three 'Not yet proven' chips (Leadership/Entry Quality/Risk); grades+scores intact, chips additive below them.
